name: Golden Designs Vorarlberg 5-Person Outdoor Traditional Sauna with Waterproof Stained Hemlock Wood
description: Vorarlberg 5-Person Outdoor Traditional Sauna with Waterproof Stained Hemlock Wood Transform your home into a luxurious spa with Golden Designs' Vorarlberg 5-Person Outdoor Traditional Sauna. This water-proof sauna, made from stained hemlock wood, brings the ultimate relaxation and rejuvenation experience to any space - even smaller ones. Introduce a healthier way of living with Golden Design's traditional steam saunas. Experience the multitude of health benefits that come with owning a traditional steam sauna. Choose to improve your lifestyle today. Features Delivery: This item will be delivered curbside only on a pallet by a freight carrier. Capacity: Full 5 person capacity Stove: 8.0 kw Stove with built in controls Wood Type: Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock with Water Proof Stain on the Exterior Glass: Bronze Privacy Tempered glass door Interior Lighting: Interior Chromotherapy Color Lighting System Interior backrest with accent light Control Panels: Interior LED Control Panel with built in FM Station and Bluetooth Connection Sound System: Built in Performance Speakers Accessories: Sandglass, bucket, and scoop Temperature Range: Tradtional Stove: 170-185 is the ideal temperature range, sauna can heat up to 190F Electrical service: 240V / 40AMP (Stove) and 120V / 15AMP (Control for Lights and Music) (Please consult a certified electrician.) Location: Outdoor Use Includes Sandglass Thermometer Bucket, and scoop Specifications Capacity 5 person capacity Material 100% Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock with WaterProof Stain on the Exterior Chromotherapy Interior Chromotherapy lighting system Style Interior backrest with accent lighting Exterior Front overhang accent lighting Controls Touch Screen Control Panel with built-in FM Radio and Bluetooth Connection Sound System Built-in Performance Speakers Included Sandglass, thermometer, bucket, and scoop Construction Stainless steel hinge and handle Heater Harvia "WALL" Stove 8KW Traditional Sauna Stove with Built-in Controls Electrical Service 40AMP / 240V (Please consult a certified electrician.) Assembled Dimensions with Overhang (W x D x H) 98.9" x 72.6" x 97.4" Assembled Dimensions without Overhang (W x D x H) 78" x 56.7" x 97.4" Assembled Dimensions Interior (W x D x H) 74.2" x 53.2" x 78" Assembly & Maintenance Owners Manual Do not use any type of cleaning agent on the interior of the sauna.
